title: Trump told of hybrids living among us during his briefing
summary: Eric Burlison tells of Trump told of hybrids living among us during his briefing, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Trump was during that briefing he was told that there are hybrids and told the narrative that they were that there's hybrids that potentially live amongst us and and that Trump's response was, "You mean like Adam Schiff?"

plain: A congressman, Eric Burlison, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that during a briefing Donald Trump was told there are hybrids, part human and part something else, that may be living among us. According to Burlison, Trump's response was a joke: "You mean like Adam Schiff?", naming a politician he dislikes. The story matters to those who tell it because it would mean a president was formally briefed on such beings.
